content: Google Calendar API integration is decoupled from Better Auth login. The user authenticates via Email/Password, and then connects Google Calendar in Settings. This triggers an OAuth 2.0 flow on FastAPI (/api/auth/google/login and /api/auth/google/callback) with access_type=offline and prompt=consent to obtain a refresh token. FastAPI stores this token securely in Postgres under the user's owner_id to read/write calendar events in the background.
